title: Embedded workbench v1 representative wire contracts
description: D0 design schemas. Request fixture wrappers select the body schema; HTTP sends data only. Producer schema is closed; consumers apply documented additive-field compatibility.

objectId.description: Full opaque Git object ID; length must match repository objectFormat, never a display abbreviation.

workflowLaunch.description: Server-reported launch facts for one registered workflow option. They describe the adapter; admission rechecks capability, limits and readiness.

harnessFacts.description: Transport-neutral facts about the single agent harness an option uses. Implementation identity is present only when the server resolved that harness's configuration; credentials, paths and configuration values are never reported.

reconstructionScopeFacts.description: What a reconstruction option plans and how far a start may narrow it. The deterministic planner owns every module boundary and plans the whole program; planner bounds are scale limits, not a selection.

attemptHarness.description: Non-secret harness provenance the server resolved when the attempt was admitted. The configuration digest is the harness factory's canonical digest, never configuration content.

attemptReconstruction.description: The reconstruction profile and effective per-module context budget recorded at admission.

attemptValidation.description: The validation corpus admission bound to the attempt.

attemptConfiguration.description: The server-validated configuration recorded atomically with an attempt at admission. It is immutable; a later configuration change is recorded on a new attempt.

reconstructionScope.description: A requested lowering of an agent reconstruction's per-module context budget; the server validates it against the option's reported range.

validationCaseSelection.description: A validation request's reviewed cases: the server-approved preset and the digest of the exact corpus the caller inspected. Cases are never supplied by the caller.

implementationDeclaration.description: Recorded manifest claim only; not content verification or accepted-revision authority.

moduleProgress.description: Stage-separated progress of one reconstruction attempt from its own retained reports and durable state, and whether its retained plan could be reused. Never validation, acceptance or a recovery command.

validationCasePlan.description: The server-approved cases a validation of one recorded revision runs, for review before an explicit start. Display data, never commands or runner configuration.
